messages:
maya: Draft v3 is up — focused on the 'predictable inference' angle. Quick review please (focus: hero claim, CTA, and webinar routing).

sam_p: reading now. will check the benchmark stat in the second paragraph.

ana: small ask — can we tighten the headline to reference cost/latency tradeoff? e.g., 'ship LLM features at predictable latency and cost' feels clearer.

leo: hero visual suggestion: show a simple 2-column chart (latency vs cost) + webinar CTA on the right. sending comp in #design in 5.

chris: benchmark stat check: the 2.1x improvement number is from internal A/B test 2025-11-12; confirm it's p95 latency vs baseline, not mean.

maya: good catch — i updated to say "p95 latency". Sam, please confirm the dataset and cohort for that A/B so legal/claims can sign off.

sam_p: confirmed — cohort = webapp inference workload, shard size 64 tokens, 20k requests per experiment. i'll paste the experiment id: exp-20251112-64-20k.

liz_legal: I can quick-pass claims if you attach the experiment id + short methodology. Also need to review hero tagline for any absolute guarantees. Prefer "reduces p95 latency up to 2.1x in our benchmark" language.

maya: updated text to the softer language. attaching excerpt below:

``
Redwood Inference reduces p95 latency up to 2.1x compared to standard serving in our internal webapp workload benchmark (exp-20251112-64-20k). See methodology link: https://redwood.internal/benchmarks/exp-20251112
``

ana: looks better. can we also include UTM params for the webinar link? i want to route registrants into the Optimize funnel.

maya: yes — proposed UTM: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch_post&utm_campaign=optimize_launch_2026

``
Full webinar CTA URL: https://redwood.com/webinar/register?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch_post&utm_campaign=optimize_launch_2026&utm_content=hero_cta
``

jordan: For inbound routing — please tag registrants with "optimize_launch_2026" and add lead source = "blog-hero". Sales wants a CSV export with email, company, and interest tag within 24h of publish.

maya: noted. we'll add a zap to push leads into SFDC with that tag. @jordan can you confirm the SFDC campaign id?

jordan: campaign id = SFDC-OPT-2026-04. i'll make sure the ops team grants the zap the right permissions.

leo: small copy tweak for the hero alt text: "Dashboard showing latency vs cost improvements" — pls confirm for accessibility.

maya: confirmed. added alt text.

chris: snippet to include for the technical appendix (one-liner):

``
Serving optimizations: continuous batching + prefix KV caching + selected int8 kernels. Typical p95 improvement varies by model and sequence length. See appendix for test harness.
``

maya: perfect. one last ask — timeline? we aiming to publish Thu morning PST. publish-bot, can you queue for 2026-04-15 09:00 PT?

publish-bot: Scheduled: 2026-04-15 16:00 UTC (2026-04-15 09:00 PT). Blog post queued. Auto-publish will run link checks 30m before publication.

liz_legal: I've done a legal quick-pass. Approved copy for non-binding benchmark language. No restricted claims.

maya: awesome — looking for one final okay from design on the hero comp and from growth on UTMs.

leo: hero comp approved. dropping final PNG in the #design-assets folder.

ana: UTMs good from growth. i've added the webinar registration form snippet to the marketing site. Confirmed redirect and thank-you tracking.

maya: thanks team! i'll schedule a final preflight call 30m before publish to catch any last-minute issues. :rocket:
